obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, dominant border ink, iconography, link default

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text, card surface, dark UI block on white canvas

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surface, inverse text on dark blocks

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

smoke.$description: Smoke — Light dividers, secondary borders on cards

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled button fill, inactive controls

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted link surface, inactive background

iron.$description: Iron — Secondary body text, metadata, muted links, supporting borders

onyx.$description: Onyx — Dark mode surface (project case blocks), inverse hero panel

helvetica-now-display.$description: Display and primary voice — used at all scales from 10px micro-labels through 87px hero headlines. The custom geometric sans is the entire typographic identity.

times.$description: Secondary serif for card descriptions, footer text, editorial body copy — a deliberate contrast voice to the sans display
